card.title: 9th GUARDS REGIMENT
card.text: Destruction: Deal 2 damage to the enemy HQ, give yours +2 defense.
card.flavorText: Formed in 1944, the 9th Guards Regiment belonged to the 3rd Guards Division, one of the last Imperial Japanese Army units raised for homeland defense. Alongside the 8th and 10th Guards Regiments, it was composed of elite troops drawn from Japan’s prestigious Imperial Guard. Unlike earlier guards divisions that served in overseas campaigns, the 3rd Guards Division was never deployed abroad. Instead, it was tasked with protecting the Japanese home islands as the threat of Allied invasion grew in 1945. Stationed within Japan’s borders, the 9th Guards Regiment spent its brief existence preparing for a final stand. It did not see combat before Japan’s surrender in August 1945. Despite its short service and lack of battlefield experience, the regiment’s formation reflected the desperation of Japan during the final months of the war, when even elite units were kept in reserve to face potential landings on the mainland. The division was disbanded following the end of the war. As with other guards formations, the 9th Guards Regiment retained a ceremonial and symbolic association with the Emperor, though its role in the war remained limited to defensive preparations.
